Question: At the feast, how did the father describe his son?
OptionA: This son of mine was poor and is rich again
OptionB: This son of mine was foolish and is wise again
OptionC: This son of mine was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found
OptionD: This son of mine was far away and is home again
Explanation: The father's words sum up the whole story: what was lost had been found.
